slides.title: A workflow, revealed line by line.
slides.description: Each click adds the next block. Explain the code at your own pace.
slides.notes: This illustrative CI workflow assumes an npm project with test and build scripts. Update runtime and action versions for your repository.

steps.label: Trigger on branch pushes
steps.code:
on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']

permissions:
  contents: read

steps.label: Prepare Node.js
steps.code:
- name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

steps.label: Install, test, and build
steps.code:
- run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build
